verdict.rationale: SumUp exposes a managed MCP server and an Agent Toolkit that let MCP-compatible AI assistants and agentic frameworks (LangChain, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK) create checkouts, manage accounts, and process payments, effectively enabling natural-language-driven operation of SumUp's APIs. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that natural-language commands reliably map to correct actions, and documentation of guardrails/error handling for ambiguous NL requests.
